# fct_external_web_searches

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_external_web_searches` · dbt area: `growth`

Organic Search data aggregated by date, country, device, search type, query, and URL. Metrics include impressions, clicks, and position totals. Sourced from Google Search Console.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `search_id` | Unique Primary Key assigned to each search using a surrogate of date, country, device, search_type, query, and url. >> SOURCE - Google Search Console data_tests: - not_null - unique |
| `country` | The 3-letter country code where the search originated >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
| `clicks` | The number of click-throughs a page received for the given query(s) >> Source - Google Search Console |
| `device` | The device type where the search originated >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
| `impressions` | The number of impressions a page received for the given query(s) >> Source - Google Search Console |
| `is_query_anonymized` | True/false flag of whether the Query is Anonymized (shows as "null") >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
| `is_query_term_branded` | True/false flag of whether the Query contains a branded term ('fora', 'flora', or 'the modern travel agency') >> SOURCE - Logic on top of Google Search Console |
| `is_query_term_fora` | True/false flag of whether the Query contains the term 'fora' >> SOURCE - Logic on top of Google Search Console |
| `page_path` | The destination path of the search result (taken from the URL) >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
| `page_path_level_1` | Only the first level of the path (right after the first slash) of the search result (taken from the URL) >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
| `page_path_level_2` | Only the second level of the path (right after the second slash) of the search result (taken from the URL) >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
| `page_path_level_3` | Only the third level of the path (right after the third slash) of the search result (taken from the URL) >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
| `page_path_level_4` | Only the fourth level of the path (right after the fourth slash) of the search result (taken from the URL) >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
| `position_total` | The average position in search results that page received for the given query(s), where 1 is the top-most position >> Source - Google Search Console |
| `query` | The search query (aka the keyword) that was searched for >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
| `search_date` | The date that the search occured (technically the date the search data was loaded by the Search Console) >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
| `search_type` | Whether the search was made on the web tab, image tab, video, etc. >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
| `url` | The destination URL for the link in the search result >> SOURCE - Google Search Console |
